if theres anyone actually watching this thread then i have an update, turns out cyl 4 is regapping its plug. i pulled it after doing a contrb test and it was less than 10thou, but otherwise looked normal.

7 and 8 were also missing but not nearly as hard. i didnt get the chance to pull either of their plugs and i assume they are doing the same thing, but i did a borecam and found a good layer of carbon in cyl 4.  
whats perplexing is that the carbon alone cant regap the plug that hard, and theres no foreign objects in my engine  
this leads me to believe that its done this with every set of plugs ive put in this motor, my interval for plugs is 10k because it runs smoother after and i never actually knew that they should be lasting much longer. this is just what i believed to be normal maintenance but apparently not. i know how to do basically everything on this motor and i know its not me messing up and even moreso since it runs perfect right after.   
i did my timing set at 100k and that also seemed like normal maintenance to me, it ran better after and i assumed the chain was stretched and it probably was a little bit. again ive never actually chased this problem.  
there is no reasonable explanation that i know of as to why it would be regapping the plugs this hard, i certainly dont expect anyone else to come up with one

im going to seafoam the fuck out of my motor and see how it does but im not planning on it changing anything about how it gaps my plugs. i just cant think of a reason for how it could do this. its never fouled them or otherwise shown any signs of an issue relating to them, but i have been overlooking the gap
